hubUrl.description: PrintHub Pro hub base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9235

token.description: Hub API token (must match PRINTHUB_TOKEN of the hub)

defaultPrinter.description: Default printer name. Empty = OS default printer. Use __file__ for save-as-PDF.

hookPrint.description: Intercept window.print() calls and route them to the hub

autoPrintAllPdfs.description: Simple mode: any PDF opened in the browser is printed silently and its tab closes, no rules needed.

failFallback.description: What happens when a page's silent print call (printPdfLink / printPdf) fails: 'tab' opens the URL in a new tab (browser fallback), 'none' stays completely silent.

closeAfterPrint.description: Close the tab automatically after a rule auto-prints its URL (no browser view). Default OFF since v1.7.0 - tabs stay open unless enabled.

blockedSites.description: Hosts where auto-print (rules + print-every-PDF) is switched off. One host per entry, subdomains included.

rules.description: URL routing rules. First matching rule wins.
